ValidationRule.description: Enforces that the Broker Name and Broker Location are mandatory when the Broker Category is New.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Broker', ISPICKVAL(Broker_Category__c, 'New'), OR( ISBLANK(Broker_Name__c), ISBLANK(Broker_Location__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Broker Name and Broker Location are mandatory when the Broker Category is New.
